item.stem:
Riya wants to compare lemon juice and soap solution using turmeric paper as a natural indicator.

She plans four possible ways to do the test:

| test | P | Q | R | S |
| procedure | same turmeric paper, one drop of each liquid, final colours recorded | rose extract for lemon juice, turmeric paper for soap solution | same turmeric paper, one drop of lemon juice and ten drops of soap solution | same turmeric paper, one drop of each liquid, colours not recorded |

Which tests give a fair comparison of the two liquids?
